head: a63caa1087852ada98964678be26b7c4d8363af6

source.ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/6691; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 608, 609, 610, 612, 613; licence Apache-2.0 read from LICENSE at head; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by adjudicator after two blind vetters; the pull request's next commit 36881278bf (merged as ece59034f7) restored concurrent edge deletion, which upstream kept (v0.18.0, v0.20.0 behind a limiter); upstream 20b8ccd1e9 (#6705) later fixed removed_nodes.extend

rationale: Entity resolution merge fixes in graphrag, vetted under ADR-0036. row-608 dropped: at head line 114 lists the component set directly; the missing .nodes was the base's bug, which this change fixes. row-609 dropped and made a forbid range: trio's start_soon calls the lambda at once to build the coroutine, so each merge task gets that iteration's merging_nodes and nothing binds late. row-610 dropped and made a forbid range: index.py gives every entity a source_id and tidy_graph purges nodes without one, so no KeyError is reachable. row-612 dropped: tidy_graph guarantees edge keywords and source_id, nothing reads them in order, and it is a consistency remark. row-613 (vetters split: optional against required) is optional, origin author-fix. The awaited per-edge deletes are serial and the author restored concurrency in the next commit. But at head no removed edge reaches set_graph: removed_edges is filled only in _merge_graph_nodes after extractor.py line 196, which raises AttributeError (extend on a set) for every merge. Base never deleted concurrently either: start_soon on a synchronous delete raised TypeError. The path is a background indexing job whose per-edge LLM summaries cost far more than the deletes. The performance reviewer is told not to report parallelism ideas without a demonstrated cost, so a review that follows its prompt may rightly skip this. The line 196 crash, made reachable by this change and fixed upstream in #6705, is the change's main real defect. It is not a candidate claim and lies outside the diff's hunks, so it is left for curation.

expect.concern: Inside the nursery each removed edge's relation chunks are deleted by an awaited worker-thread call, so the deletions run one after another and set_graph pays a full doc-store delete round trip per merged-away edge.

forbid.reason: trio's start_soon calls the lambda immediately to create the coroutine, so each merge task receives its own merging_nodes list; a late-binding closure finding here is wrong.
index.py gives every entity a source_id list and tidy_graph purges nodes without one before entity resolution runs, so a missing-key failure on source_id cannot happen here.
